description: Defines the android::binder::Status class, which manages exception status and error reporting in Android's binder IPC mechanism, including methods for serialization/deserialization with Parcel objects and exception handling.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Represents the status of a binder transaction, including exception codes, messages, and error handling.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Returns a Status object representing success (no error).

methods.name: fromExceptionCode
methods.description: Creates a Status object from an exception code, with optional message.

methods.name: fromServiceSpecificError
methods.description: Creates a Status object for a service-specific error, with optional message.

methods.name: fromStatusT
methods.description: Creates a Status object from a low-level status_t code.

methods.name: exceptionToString
methods.description: Converts an exception code to a human-readable string.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Reads the status from a Parcel object.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Writes the status to a Parcel object.

methods.name: writeOverParcel
methods.description: Replaces the contents of a Parcel with this status.

methods.name: setException
methods.description: Sets the status as an exception with a code and message.

methods.name: setServiceSpecificError
methods.description: Sets a service-specific error code and message.

methods.name: setFromStatusT
methods.description: Sets the status from a low-level status_t code.

methods.name: transactionError
methods.description: Returns the error code for a failed transaction.

methods.name: isOk
methods.description: Checks if the status indicates success.

methods.name: toString8
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the status for logging.
